Subject: Request: Boundary conformance letter + operator inventory + SOC2 evidence (EU)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking the time on Friday. To move Acme's procurement and security review forward we need two pieces from Redwood for the EU hosting scope: 1) a signed "Boundary Conformance" letter that confirms the service footprint for Acme's tenant (EU-only nodes, private endpoint/privatelink, KMS partitioning), and 2) a completed operator inventory listing the people/groups with production operator access.

Separately, our security team asked for a high level SOC 2 attestation summary and CAIQ/ SIG pointer for the EU private deployment. We'd like to consolidate everything into a single PDF packet for our legal/procurement review. Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts and sign via DocuSign? Target cutoff for our review is 2025-08-10.

Thanks,
Samir

Looping you all — Acme wants a signed boundary conformance letter + operator inventory + SOC2/CAIQ pointers for EU private hosting. Summary of asks: 
- Boundary Conformance letter: confirms EU-only hosting, private endpoint topology, KMS partitioning and no shared operator access outside enumerated inventory.
- Operator inventory: CSV/XLSX template with names, roles, access methods (bastion/jump/ops-console), and justification.
- SOC 2 summary + CAIQ answers or link to SIG/CAIQ pack; Acme prefers a single combined PDF.

Proposed owners: Marissa (customer liaison + acceptance), Rishi (technical evidence & operator inventory), Hannah (compliance sign-off). Can we do a first-draft packet by Wednesday 07/30 so we can hand the DocuSign link to Samir by Friday? Please post what you need from legal or infra.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Boundary conformance letter + operator inventory + SOC2 evidence (EU)

Thanks Chloe — quick technical notes and what I can provide: 

Available artifacts (I can assemble as single PDF):
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (summary page + scope appendix) — Redwood-hosted (no customer data excerpts).
- CAIQ answers (redacted) & link to our SIG/CAIQ repo.
- Boundary conformance letter (we have a template) that states: EU region nodes only for this tenant, private endpoint (VPC peering/privatelink) used for production traffic, KMS key partitioned per-tenant with customer-controlled CMK where requested, and that operator access is restricted to named roles.
- Operator inventory: I'll fill the operator-inventory-template.xlsx with names/roles and access vectors; we will not include passwords or keys — only account IDs and access method.

Two clarifying questions for Acme (please confirm so I can finalize wording):
1) By "EU-only nodes" do they require physical-hosting-region guarantee (AZ-level avoidance of cross-border failover) or is regional AWS/EU-central (single region) sufficient?
2) Audit log retention: they asked for "audit logs" — do they need per-tenant log export (we can provide aggregated logs and can enable per-tenant export for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted customers have limited direct export).

I can have drafts attached by Wed 07/30 EOD. If they want a combined signed PDF we should route to Legal for the signature clause; otherwise we can provide a DocuSign-ready document.

--Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf (redwood-soc2-summary), CAIQ-answers-redwood.xlsx (redacted), boundary-conformance-letter-template.docx
